$t = \text{time taken.}$
$Q(t) = \text{amount of water in the tank in time } t$
$\therefore Q(t) = Q_0 \pm qt$
$'+' \text{ sign at the time of flowing of water in and '-' sign, at the time of flowing of water out are to be used.}$

Suppose, $b = \text{total quantity}$
$r = \text{rate of percentage} = \frac{s}{100} = s\%$
$p = \text{part of percentage } s\% \text{ of } b$
$\therefore p = br$

Suppose, $C = \text{cost price}$
$r = \text{rate of profit or loss}$
$\therefore \text{selling price } S = C(1 \pm r)$
$\text{in case of profit, } S = C(1 + r)$
$\text{in case of loss, } S = C(1 - r)$

Suppose, $I = \text{profit after time } n$
$n = \text{specific time}$
$P = \text{principal}$
$r = \text{profit of unit principal at unit time}$
$A = \text{principal with profit after time } n$
$\text{In the case of simple profit,}$
$I = Pnr$
$A = P + I = P + Pnr = P(1 + nr)$
$\text{In the case of compound profit,}$
$A = P(1 + r)^n$
